const has=v=>v!=null&&v!=='',rec=v=>typeof v==='object'&&v!==null&&!Array.isArray(v),id=(v,f)=>{if(!has(v))return;const s=String(v).trim();if(!/^\d+$/.test(s))throw new Error(f+' must be a numeric Freshsales ID, got "'+s+'".');return Number(s)},selector=b=>{if(!rec(b))return[];const r=Object.values(b).find(x=>Array.isArray(x));if(!Array.isArray(r))return[];const o=[];for(const i of r){if(!rec(i)||i.id===undefined)continue;const t=i.display_name??i.name??i.currency_code??i.email;o.push({id:String(i.id),name:t==null?String(i.id):String(t),email:typeof i.email=='string'?i.email:undefined,position:typeof i.position=='number'?i.position:undefined})}return o};
return {users:selector(response).map(o=>({id:o.id,name:o.name,email:o.email??null}))};

get_custom_fields.label: Get Fields
get_custom_fields.description: List the fields (incl. custom cf_ fields) of a record type
get_custom_fields.beforeRequest:
const r=inputs.entity;if(!['contacts','sales_accounts','deals','sales_activities'].includes(r))throw new Error('Unsupported Record Type "'+r+'".');request.url='/settings/'+r+'/fields';
return request;
